First, I need to break down each component. Request routing involves how requests are directed to different parts of the system. Maybe using a queuing system like a FIFO or priority queue. Queueing would handle incoming requests, and tail latency refers to the time a request takes to be processed. Cache transfer is about moving data between cache and main memory, which affects latency. Role switching might involve different workers handling different tasks, which affects batch completion. GPU utilization is about how much GPU resources are used, and throughput tradeoffs relate to efficiency between these factors.
